title: CloudKeeper’s AI cost dashboard includes licences and GPU spending
summary: CloudKeeper’s AI cost platform covers models, tokens, licences, GPU usage and cloud spending. Follow the underlying charge before treating a dashboard as a total.
body_markdown:
##


Keep insight access separate from changes


The[announcement](https://en.prnasia.com/releases/apac/cloudkeeper-makes-ai-llm-cost-tracking-easier-for-businesses-with-full-stack-finops-for-ai-553871.shtml) says MCP support lets businesses connect their own LLMs to access cost insights and recommendations inside existing workflows.


Its[product page](https://www.cloudkeeper.com/full-stack-finops-for-ai) also markets rate and usage optimisation, including GPU rightsizing. It does not specify which MCP tool, if any, executes those changes.


A request to explain a rising bill and a request to resize capacity are different handoffs. One seeks an explanation; the other proposes changing a resource. The proposed change needs an identified target and approval from its owner. This is a workflow distinction, not a claim about permission controls OpenTools verified in CloudKeeper.


The company’s general savings claims are not evidence of this new product’s results.


AI‑generated conceptual illustration of compute hardware, blank software‑access cards and a blank cost record. It is not CloudKeeper’s interface, a real bill or evidence of measured savings. Original artwork by OpenTools Team.
